identifier_sources.gbif: api.gbif.org/v1/species/{key} (accepted usage looked up by key)
identifier_sources.ncbi: eutils esearch db=taxonomy + esummary (rank and name checked)
identifier_sources.wikidata: wbsearchentities + wbgetentities; item chosen whose P225 taxon name / P846 GBIF id matches
identifier_sources.itis: TSN from Wikidata P815, verified with ITIS getScientificNameFromTSN
identifier_sources.worms: AphiaID from Wikidata P850, verified with WoRMS AphiaRecordByAphiaID

notes: Lubbock's Coccus (scale insects, Hemiptera: Coccidae). GBIF species/match returns no match for 'Coccus' because of homonyms; the genus usage 2049629 (Coccus Linnaeus, 1758, Coccidae) was looked up by key and verified. Lubbock's 1859 paper concerned Coccus hesperidum (GBIF 5712981, NCBI 538890).
